links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM-generated patient instructions with simple vs detailed prompts
links.effect: Simple prompts: ChatGPT 4.0 at 10th-grade level, Gemini 1.0 Pro at 7th-grade level. Both LLMs produced 6th-grade level outputs with detailed prompts.
links.quote: Simple prompts resulted in ChatGPT 4.0 outputs at a 10th-grade reading level, while Gemini 1.0 Pro outputs were at a 7th-grade level.

links.outcome: Understandability and actionability of LLM patient education material (PEMAT-P)
links.effect: ChatGPT 4.0 mean understandability 80% and actionability 60%; Gemini 1.0 Pro 67% and 60%. Detailed prompts yielded outputs comprehensible to the average adult.
links.quote: ChatGPT 4.0 had mean understandability and actionability scores of 80% and 60%, respectively, compared with 67% and 60% for Gemini 1.0 Pro.
